meta.name: sdk-design
meta.description: Doctrine for designing and evolving any **SDK** Grida ships — TypeScript, Rust, or otherwise. "SDK" here means a surface that crosses a foreign-or-foreign-treated boundary: published packages, separately-versioned consumers, FFI bindings, public-by-design modules. An SDK's job is to refuse; a strict, honest surface rejects the wrong contents and keeps the package testable in isolation. Default is "core, not customizable"; customization is the exception, defended by a deciding table. Use when authoring or evolving any such surface — `@grida/*` published packages, `crates/*` published or FFI-exported, intent/message vocabularies, any contract a second author will compile against. Internal-only helper packages are welcome to follow, not forced. Companion skill for two-sided contract work: $sdk-seam. Critique partners: $pedantic, $etiology. Related: $naming.

howto.what: Claude 会按照一套原则来设计或改进 SDK，确保它只暴露必要的接口，拒绝不合适的输入，保持包小巧、可测试、可替换。
howto.when: 当你在编写或演进任何跨越外部边界的包（如 `@grida/*` 发布包、`crates/*` 发布或 FFI 导出、意图/消息词汇表等）时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计这个 SDK 的公共接口，确保它只暴露核心功能。
say.note: Claude 会应用默认核心、定制为例外的原则。

say.text: 检查这个包是否应该添加一个可定制选项。
say.note: Claude 会使用决策表判断是否应为核心或提供者。

howto.what_en: Claude will follow a doctrine to design or evolve any SDK, ensuring it exposes only necessary interfaces, rejects wrong inputs, and keeps the package small, testable, and replaceable.
howto.when_en: Triggered when authoring or evolving any surface that crosses a foreign-or-foreign-treated boundary, such as published packages, FFI bindings, or shared message vocabularies.

say_en.text: Help me design the public API for this SDK, keeping it minimal.
say_en.note: Claude applies the default-core, customization-exception principle.

say_en.text: Check if this package should add a customizable option.
say_en.note: Claude uses the deciding table to determine if it should be core or provider.
